subject: Can if () conditional statement be used in the transformed data block?

messages.author: bd5bc5f871f1409b
messages.subject: Can if () conditional statement be used in the transformed data block?
parts:
Hi, mailing list users,
I am trying to creat a new variable in the transformed data block, this transformed variable combines the missing and know value. I want to use a "if" statement to assign the known value to the new transformed variable. But it dose not seem to accept the if statement in stan, I do not want to seperate the models for missing and observed values.
any suggestions?
thank you , Irene

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Can if () conditional statement be used in the transformed data block?
parts:
Yes, you can use an if statement in the transformed
data block.

But if the missing data is a parameter, then you need
to put the two together in the transformed parameter block.

So if your model's not compiling, there must be another
issue. Could you send us the Stan code you're trying
to get working?

- Bob
